sources.entry: moOde Audio - Audiophile-quality music playback for the wonderful Raspberry Pi family of single board computers. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: moOde audio player is a Raspberry Pi music playback system with a web-based UI for audiophile-oriented playback, built on MPD.
summary.what_it_does: moOde provides a responsive web user interface for playing music on Raspberry Pi single board computers. It is a redesigned derivative of an earlier WebUI player for MPD (Music Player Daemon), and the README describes it as having an extensive set of audiophile-grade features. The project ships its own OS image and uses Debian packaging plus the Pi-gen image builder for its build tooling. The README states the player has no ads, subscriptions, cookies, or analytics, and that configuration data is stored on the local boot media. Support is provided through a community forum rather than in the repository itself.
use_cases: Turn a Raspberry Pi into a dedicated music player
Play music from an MPD library through a web browser
Build a custom Raspberry Pi audio appliance image
notable: Derived from an earlier WebUI player for MPD, now fully redesigned
Ships as a complete OS image for Raspberry Pi
States no ads, tracking, cookies, or subscriptions
Build tooling uses standard Debian packages and Pi-gen
caveats: Requires Raspberry Pi hardware; the README targets the Raspberry Pi family
Support is handled through a forum; the repository is for developer activity such as pull requests and bug reports
Setup instructions are not in the README; it points to a separate setup guide and documentation site
keywords: turn raspberry pi into music player
